title: FieldRead
description: Output of `field read`. With a `<fieldPathInModel>` argument: one field read back — its value `kind`, friendly `required` state, metadata (`label`/descriptions/`annotations`), and the per-kind CONFIG block in the SAME shape `field add` accepts (`number`/`string`/`enum`/`date`/…). A typedef-typed field also carries the `typedef` id and the `resolvedType` (the type definition's own config). With NO argument: a lean name-index — `fields` (every field's full path) + `count` — the handle to then read one.

kind.description: (one field) the value kind — the SAME vocabulary the `field add` `kind` key takes and `model describe` reports (STRING | NUMBER | BOOLEAN | CONFIRM | DATE | DATE_TIME | TIME | DATE_FRAGMENT | DATE_RANGE | ENUMERATION | CUSTOM | UNKNOWN); a typedef-typed field reports its resolved underlying kind (never the raw kernel discriminator), with the `typedef` pointer below

required.description: (one field) the friendly requiredness — `true`/`false`, or `"ifParentPresent"`; same vocabulary the `required` write key takes

label.description: (one field) the field's label, locale → text

internalDescription.description: (one field) the internal description, locale → text

externalDescription.description: (one field) the external/help description, locale → text

annotations.description: (one field) the field's annotations, name → value

number.description: (one field, NUMBER) min/max/unit/scale/rendered-length/integer-digit config, the shape `field add` accepts

enum.description: (one field, ENUMERATION) the allowed values + labels, plus any categories and per-locale invalid-value errorMessages

typedef.description: (one field) the reusable type definition this field is typed by — present only for a typedef-typed field

resolvedType.description: (one field) the referenced type definition's own per-kind config, resolved so a constraint on the reusable type is confirmable through this read alone

fields.description: (name-index) every field's full name-path, in document order — pass one back as `field read <path>`
